title: Disneyland to LAX Transportation: Limo or Private Car?
description: Compare limo and private car options for Disneyland to LAX transportation, including comfort, luggage, travel time, and airport transfer tips.
h1: Why Plan Disneyland to LAX Transportation in Advance?

blocks.text: If you’re visiting Disneyland in Anaheim and have a flight departing from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), planning your transportation in advance can make the final part of your trip much easier. Disneyland is approximately 40 miles from LAX, and travelers have several transportation options, including rideshare services, taxis, private cars, shuttles, and limousines .

blocks.text: There are many terminals at LAX and there are particular protocols related to dropping off and picking up passengers. Those who take private vehicles and limousines need to know which terminal is best for meeting them and what the procedure of dropping them off is. Both vehicles can be ideal depending on the travel conditions.

blocks.text: Go for a Limo When:

items: Luxury is what you require from your ride.
There are several people going with you, such as family members.
There are several bags along with you.
Professional driver is a must for you.
You have any celebration planned.
Comfortable and spacious vehicle appeals to you.

blocks.text: Go for a Private Car When:

items: You are traveling alone or with one or two companions.
Your baggage is minimal.
You do not require anything more than an airport pickup.
You need no additional seating room.
You want a private ride without a larger vehicle.
